Nephrotic syndrome secondary to the diabetic nephropathy or CKD. \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; 2)Reasons for I) Azotemia : impaired renal excretion of urea and creatinine secondary to CKD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;II) Anemia : decreased erythropoietin.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIII) Hypoalbunemia: capillary basement membrane and podocytes damage.kidney cannot filter protein \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAcidosis-accumulation of H+ and loss of HCO3\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) Rationale : syp potchlor was given because of the hypokalemia.. Inj. NaHCO3 was given because of metabolic acidosis ..Insulin and antihypertensives are given because known case of DM and HTN. Orofer XT was given because of anemia.. Inj. Lasix was given to decrease her volume overload. Spironolactone was given it was a potassium sparing diuretic.Calcium was given to the patient \u0026nbsp;because of hypocalcemia secondary to CKD. Indications of NaHCO3:metabolic acidosis in cardiac arrest, Tricyclic antidepressants, aspirin and phenobarbitone overdoses, Hyperkalemia, Crush injuries, C\/I \u0026nbsp;in certain conditions because of adverse reactions like Hypernatremia, metabolic alkalosis, cellulitis, seizures, Tetany, sodium retention, peripheral edema. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;4) indication of dialysis in this pt: worsening of SOB secondary to metabolic acidosis with Anuria not resolved with high ceiling diuretics...Crucial factor: pt became symptomatic on 3rd day.... \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; 5) Causes of same condition : primary : Minimal change disease, Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, Membranous nephropathy. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Secondary : DM, SLE, HIV , Viral hepatitis, malaria, amyloidosis, \u0026nbsp;Sarcoidosis, Drugs : Nsaids, gold, pencillamine Cancer: Hodgkin's and non Hodgkin's, solid tumours of GIT, RCC and lung.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6)expected outcomes of ckd patients depend upon age,genes,associated co morbidities \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; This patients condition may deteriorate due to pleural effusion\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC5261605\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E7)association of ckd with hrpef\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EActivation of raas system\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHypercalcemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHyperphosphatemia\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUremic toxins .these critically discuss the potentail contribution to coronary dysfunction, left ventricular stiffening \u0026nbsp;and delayed left ventricular relaxation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8)mean Hemoglobin levels,before and after study,in rhuepo group we’re 8.85+ or - 1.01g\/do and 9.90+ or - 0.29 g\/dl,respectively(p less than 0.001) and in control group were,9.00+ or -g\/dl and 7.81 + or - g\/dl,respectively\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC4293514\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E9)Anaemia contributes to the impairment of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients with CKD [7].
